    Path actions on string modules (Step 1 of Proposition 3.8) #

    A path acts nonzero on M(w) exactly when it is spelled by a walk of the string diagram (pval_mem_annihilator_iff), and the nonzero path actions are linearly independent, since their matrices have nonempty disjoint supports (linIndep_pathAction).
